_comment: Copy to ~/.config/frame-google-sync/config.json and chmod 600. client_id/secret from your Google Cloud OAuth client (Desktop app). ha_token: HA Profile -> Security -> Long-Lived Access Tokens. Never commit the real file.
_comment_ha_url: Use the external/relay URL, not the LAN IP: macOS Local Network privacy blocks non-Apple binaries (node, python) from LAN IPs (EHOSTUNREACH), and the launchd job has no Terminal to inherit permission from. External HTTPS is unaffected.
